svg.title: Document Q&A AWS demo architecture
svg.desc: A local browser calls an HTTPS Application Load Balancer, which routes to one Amazon ECS Fargate task in a public subnet in the us-east-1 default VPC. The task uses a PostgreSQL pgvector EC2 host, S3, Amazon Bedrock, Secrets Manager, ECR, and CloudWatch. Security group and IAM boundaries are shown.
svg.text: Live backend · us-east-1 · default VPC · one Fargate task · frontend remains local

g.text: Public · HTTPS terminates here · HTTP redirects to HTTPS
Security group: internet 80/443 · target task SG 8000 only
Public IP for outbound AWS service access
Task SG accepts port 8000 from ALB SG only
Task role: scoped S3 + Bedrock permissions
Ingress from task SG only · public subnet/public IP
Execution role pulls the API image

svg.text: Task public IP provides outbound access; keeps demo cost down.
Execution role: ECR, secret read, logs. Task role: model calls and S3 users/* only. DB remains in a public subnet.
Official AWS Architecture Icons (July 2026 release), from aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/ · diagram reflects deployment/resources.json.
